superiorstory.contract.bait.title: Something Took the Bait
superiorstory.contract.bait.offer: You'll need {item:notsoshrimple:crayfish_bait_bucket} to lure {entity:notsoshrimple:crayfish}. Drop the bait into suitable water, then bring me one {item:notsoshrimple:raw_prawn}.
superiorstory.contract.bait.reward: Choose one Unique weapon from four random choices. You also receive 2 × {item:superior_affixes:orb_of_infusion}, {item:superior_gambling:rare_boots_loot_box}, 100 coins, and reputation.
superiorstory.contract.bait.thanks: One {item:notsoshrimple:raw_prawn}, as requested. Your reward is ready.
superiorstory.contract.bait.accepted: Bring me one {item:notsoshrimple:raw_prawn} when you're ready to claim the reward.
superiorstory.contract.crypt.title: Silence the Crypt
superiorstory.contract.crypt.offer: I'll mark a Draugr Crypt. Defeat {entity:mebahelcreaturesdraugr:draugr_overlord} and bring me one {item:mebahelcreaturesdraugr:ebony_ingot}.
superiorstory.contract.crypt.reward: Choose one Unique weapon from four random choices. You also receive {item:superior_dungeons:realmkey}, 2 × {item:superior_affixes:orb_of_ascension}, 250 coins, and reputation.
superiorstory.contract.crypt.thanks: One {item:mebahelcreaturesdraugr:ebony_ingot}, as requested. Your reward is ready.
superiorstory.contract.crypt.accepted: Bring me one {item:mebahelcreaturesdraugr:ebony_ingot} when you're ready to claim the reward.
superiorstory.contract.centurion.title: Shut Down the Centurion
superiorstory.contract.centurion.offer: I'll mark Raldbthar. Find {entity:mebahelcreaturesdwarven:dwarven_centurion} among the automatons and bring me one {item:mebahelelderscrollscore:dwarven_oil}.
superiorstory.contract.centurion.reward: Choose one Unique weapon from four random choices. You also receive {item:superior_dungeons:realmkey}, 2 × {item:superior_affixes:orb_of_reforging}, 300 coins, and reputation.
superiorstory.contract.centurion.thanks: One {item:mebahelelderscrollscore:dwarven_oil}, as requested. Your reward is ready.
superiorstory.contract.centurion.accepte: Bring me one {item:mebahelelderscrollscore:dwarven_oil} when you're ready to claim the reward.
superiorstory.contract.orchid.title: The Orchid Offering
superiorstory.contract.orchid.offer: Take {item:oddities:orchid_heart} to the Orchid Shrine and use it on the altar. Defeat {entity:oddities:queen_of_orchid} and bring back one {item:oddities:orchid_queen_carapace}.
superiorstory.contract.orchid.reward: Choose one Unique weapon from four random choices. You also receive {item:superior_dungeons:realmkey}, 2 × {item:superior_affixes:orb_of_socketing}, 350 coins, and reputation.
superiorstory.contract.orchid.thanks: One {item:oddities:orchid_queen_carapace}, as requested. Your reward is ready.
superiorstory.contract.orchid.accepted: Bring me one {item:oddities:orchid_queen_carapace} when you're ready to claim the reward.
superiorstory.contract.fort.title: Break the Illager Fort
superiorstory.contract.fort.offer: I'll mark an Illager Fort. Defeat {entity:minecraft:evoker} inside and bring back one {item:minecraft:totem_of_undying}. Expect {entity:minecraft:pillager} and {entity:minecraft:vindicator} guards.
superiorstory.contract.fort.reward: Choose one Unique weapon from four random choices. You also receive {item:superior_dungeons:realmkey}, {item:superior_gambling:rare_chestplate_loot_box}, 2 × {item:superior_affixes:orb_of_ascension}, 300 coins, and reputation.
superiorstory.contract.fort.thanks: One {item:minecraft:totem_of_undying}, as requested. Your reward is ready.
superiorstory.contract.fort.accepted: Bring me one {item:minecraft:totem_of_undying} when you're ready to claim the reward.
superiorstory.contract.grimoire.title: The Soul Sage's Grimoire
superiorstory.contract.grimoire.offer: Find {entity:illagerrevolutionmod:soul_sage} in a raid and bring me one {item:illagerrevolutionmod:ominous_grimoire}. It's a rare drop, so this bounty may take several fights. Watch for {entity:illagerrevolutionmod:blade_knight} and {entity:illagerrevolutionmod:illager_beast_tamer}.
superiorstory.contract.grimoire.reward: Choose one Unique weapon from four random choices. You also receive {item:superior_dungeons:exalted_realmkey}, 4 × {item:superior_affixes:orb_of_exaltation}, {item:superior_gambling:mythical_chestplate_loot_box}, 1000 coins, and reputation.
superiorstory.contract.grimoire.thanks: One {item:illagerrevolutionmod:ominous_grimoire}, as requested. Your reward is ready.
superiorstory.contract.grimoire.accepted: Bring me one {item:illagerrevolutionmod:ominous_grimoire} when you're ready to claim the reward.
superiorstory.contract.greeting: I have work for a capable fighter.
superiorstory.contract.ask: Looking for work, or bringing something back?
superiorstory.contract.choice.turn_in: I brought the items you wanted.
superiorstory.contract.jobs: Choose a contract. Bring back its requested item to collect the reward. You can complete these contracts again.
superiorstory.contract.search: Let me find the place for you.
superiorstory.contract.found: The {structure} is {distance} blocks {direction}. Accept the contract and I'll mark it on your map.
superiorstory.contract.hand: Any other items to report? You can also hand an item in from its contract page.
superiorstory.contract.nothing: I couldn't find a suitable location from here. Ask again elsewhere.
superiorstory.beat.1: Something that slumbered for eons has been disturbed.
superiorstory.beat.2: Every being that arrives here was meant to...
superiorstory.beat.4: Whatever caused this, you won't survive long enough to find it.
superiorstory.beat.5: At least not without a path.
superiorstory.prompt.skilltree: Press %s to open your Skill Tree
superiorstory.prompt.open_tree: Click to open your Skill Tree
superiorstory.command.open_failed: Could not open %s: it is not a dialogue with a trigger, or its conditions do not pass.
superiorstory.command.reset: The intro will play again for %s next time they join this world.
superiorstory.command.forget: %s will be sent to structures again, including ones they were already sent to.
superiorstory.blocked.cooldown: I've nothing for you yet. Come back in {cooldown}.
superiorstory.blocked.night: Not while the sun's up. Come back after dark.
superiorstory.blocked.day: Not in this darkness. Come back when it's light.
superiorstory.blocked.done: You've already done this for me. I won't forget it.
superiorstory.blocked.not_ready: You haven't finished the job yet.
superiorstory.bounty.line.looking: Let me see what work I have for you...
superiorstory.bounty.offer.item: I need {bounty_obj_1_amount} {bounty_obj_1_name}, and I'll pay for them.
superiorstory.bounty.offer.entity: There's a threat that needs ending: {bounty_obj_1_amount} {bounty_obj_1_name}.
superiorstory.bounty.offer.item_tag: I'm short on supplies. I need {bounty_obj_1}.
superiorstory.bounty.offer.criteria: There's a task that needs doing: {bounty_obj_1}.
superiorstory.bounty.offer.command: I have a job for you: {bounty_obj_1}.
superiorstory.bounty.offer.generic: I have a job for you. {bounty_obj_1}.
superiorstory.bounty.accepted: Good. Bring the bounty back to me when it's done.
superiorstory.bounty.declined: Another time, then. The offer will keep for a while.
superiorstory.bounty.turn_in.done: You've finished it. I can see it in your pack.
superiorstory.bounty.none: I've no work for you right now.
superiorstory.bounty.blocked.active: You still have work from me to finish.
superiorstory.bounty.blocked.gone: That offer is gone. Ask me again.
superiorstory.bounty.blocked.none: You aren't carrying any of my bounties.
superiorstory.bounty.blocked.expired: That bounty has expired. It's no use to either of us now.
superiorstory.bounty.reward.1: For your trouble I'll give you {bounty_rew_1_amount} {bounty_rew_1_name}.
superiorstory.bounty.ask: It's {bounty_rarity} work, and you'd have {bounty_time}. Will you take it?
superiorstory.bounty.active.1: You're already on my job: {bounty_obj_1_have} of {bounty_obj_1_amount} {bounty_obj_1_name} so far.
superiorstory.bounty.active.time: Come back when it's done. You have {bounty_time} left.
superiorstory.blocked.no_items: There is nothing to ask of you right now.
superiorstory.blocked.no_fish: There are not enough kinds of fish for that here.
superiorstory.guide.fishing.greet.1: Mind the line, {~friend}. Something is nibbling.
superiorstory.guide.fishing.greet.night: Night fishing, {~friend}? The strange ones come up after dark.
superiorstory.guide.fishing.greet.rain: Rain on the water. Best weather there is, {~friend}.
superiorstory.guide.fishing.ask: What brings you to the water?
superiorstory.guide.fishing.hint.1: Every fish keeps its own habits. Learn them and the water opens up.
superiorstory.guide.fishing.hint.2: A rod is only half the trick. Knowing where to cast is the rest.
superiorstory.guide.fishing.offer.lookin: Let me think what I am short of...
superiorstory.guide.fishing.offer.none: Nothing more for now. Come back when you've got a few more catches in you.
superiorstory.guide.fishing.fact.gear: You'll want {fish_1_gear} on your line for that one.
superiorstory.guide.fishing.accepted: Good. I'll be here, same spot as always.
superiorstory.guide.fishing.remind: Not yet, I see. I asked you for {fish}.
superiorstory.guide.fishing.nothing: Hm. I can't think where you'd find that from here. Ask me again later.
superiorstory.guide.fishing.praise.1: Now that is a proper catch.
superiorstory.guide.fishing.praise.2: Fine fish. You have the knack.
superiorstory.guide.fishing.praise.3: Look at that. The water likes you.
superiorstory.guide.fishing.unlocked.tie: You have earned better tackle. I have told the traders: {item:starcatcher:copper_hook} and fresh bait are yours to buy, and you know how to make them now.
The traders will sell you {item:starcatcher:steady_bobber} and {item:starcatcher:stone_hook} now, and the uncommon catch is worth selling.
Take the {item:starcatcher:amethyst_hook}. It laughs at lava. The traders will stock it for you from now on.
With a {item:starcatcher:cloud_bobber} your line will float in open air, where the void fish swim. The traders have it now.
There is nothing left I can teach you. The finest tackle there is, {item:starcatcher:legendary_bait} included, is yours to buy.
superiorstory.guide.fishing.locked.tier_: The fisherman has not trusted you with this yet: help him with common fish.
The fisherman has not trusted you with this yet: help him with uncommon fish.
The fisherman has not trusted you with this yet: help him with rare fish.
The fisherman has not trusted you with this yet: help him with epic fish.
